objective: Confirm whether the fixed eight-view D4 detector improvement from EXP207 transfers to all 175 reciprocal embryo-held-out movies and composes with the EXP209 frontier.
evidence_context: EXP207 selected this mechanism on the already-open 24-movie development cohort. No eight-view D4 prediction or metric has been computed on the 175-movie confirmation cohort.

fixed_inference.detector_views: all eight inverse-aligned D4 XY transforms

cohort_and_ordering_gate.rule: Each immutable chunk must pass PASS_EXP211_D4_CHUNK_STRUCTURE_NO_METRICS and its SHA manifest. No scientific value may be opened until one all-eight exact coverage gate passes.

preregistered_policies: D4 registered min8/min3 versus the exact four-view EXP190 parent
D4 registered forward min8 plus frozen EXP191 reverse versus the corresponding four-view composition
D4 intensity-centroid forward radius (3,5,5) min8 plus frozen EXP191 reverse versus the EXP209 frontier
primary_confirmation_gate: The pure D4 detector policy must have positive pooled delta versus EXP190, nonnegative delta in each embryo direction, paired direction-stratified bootstrap q025 above zero and minimum LOMO above zero.
frontier_gate: Promote the frozen composed policy only if it exceeds EXP209 pooled OOF 0.6815218332750073 with paired bootstrap q025 and minimum LOMO above zero. Report all direction, per-movie, edge, adjusted-edge, node and division diagnostics without retuning on these 175 movies.
tests: 8 focused tests pass: six chunk/runner/D4 tests and two all-eight gate tests

resource_plan.queue_policy: Request one bounded chunk at a time and re-check the common queue before the next chunk.
